h: Cash showers and a mystery spender: guests reportedly splash dollars at Zlatan Ibile's wedding
p: Davido and singer OGB Recent are said to have showered Zlatan Ibile and his bride with bundles of cash, while an unidentified man reportedly sprayed money on actress Iyabo Ojo. Fans have been asking who the man is, and the spraying has stirred debate online. Davido's playful answer about his favourite food at the event has also been widely shared.
more: Videos of the spraying have been shared widely on social media.
Davido's reply naming his wife Chioma drew warm reactions.
Fans are still trying to identify the man who sprayed Iyabo Ojo.
